compendiums.indexBuilding: Building the creature index for the compendiums. This can take a moment.
compendiums.indexFailed: The creature index could not be built: {reason}

writableCompendiums.name: Compendiums · Release list
writableCompendiums.hint: Which compendiums the AI may write to. Empty: every unlocked compendium. Filled: only the listed compendium ids or package names, and their lock no longer holds the AI back.

enableEnhancedCreatureIndex.name: Compendiums · Use the creature index
enableEnhancedCreatureIndex.hint: Keeps the values of every creature in the actor compendiums at hand, so creatures can be filtered by their values. Off: the search estimates from names.

autoRebuildIndex.name: Compendiums · Rebuild the creature index automatically
autoRebuildIndex.hint: Marks the creature index as outdated when an actor in a compendium changes, and rebuilds it on the next search.
